# Gradient Fellows

> A talent investment programme for non-CS STEM graduates transitioning into AI & Machine Learning. We provide micro-stipends, mentorship, and structured learning paths.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://gradientfellows.org/): Fellowship overview, programme tiers, eligibility, FAQ
- [About](https://gradientfellows.org/about): Mission, values, leadership, and company story
- [Apply](https://gradientfellows.org/apply): Application form and process for prospective fellows
- [Projects](https://gradientfellows.org/projects): AI projects built by Gradient Fellows
- [Blog](https://gradientfellows.org/blog): Career guides for STEM-to-AI transitions
- [Privacy](https://gradientfellows.org/privacy): Privacy policy (GDPR and CCPA compliant)

## Programme Structure

- Ignition (3 months, $200/mo): ML fundamentals, first portfolio project
- Orbit (6 months, $200/mo): Domain-specific ML, deep learning, open-source contributions
- Escape Velocity (12 months, $200/mo): Capstone research, interview prep, industry introductions
